evidence.title: Mycelial Search: A Graph-Structured Metaheuristic for Continuous Optimisation

summary: Researchers introduced Mycelial Search, a novel graph-structured metaheuristic inspired by fungal mycelium, aimed at solving continuous optimization problems. Benchmarks show it outperforms several existing algorithms, suggesting a promising direction for future optimization research.
title: New Graph-Structured Metaheuristic 'Mycelial Search' Advances Continuous Optimization
